parts.title: Conversations
parts.prompt: You will hear a short conversation. Answer the question about it.

questions.audio:
F|Hello, I’m calling about the printer I ordered. It arrived yesterday, but it doesn’t work.
M|I’m very sorry about that. Do you have your order number?
F|Yes, it’s 6638.
M|Thank you. We’ll send you a replacement today.
questions.explanation: Transcription : Femme : Hello, I’m calling about the printer I ordered. It arrived yesterday, but it doesn’t work. / Homme : I’m very sorry about that. Do you have your order number? / Femme : Yes, it’s 6638. / Homme : Thank you. We’ll send you a replacement today.
questions.text: What will the man do?

questions.audio:
M|Have you seen Kate? I need to ask her about the budget.
F|She must be at lunch. Her coat isn’t here.
M|OK, I’ll send her an email instead.

questions.text: What does the woman think about Kate?

M|That’s because the new shop opened late. It should improve next month.
F|I hope so. Let’s discuss it on Friday.

parts.title: Annonces
parts.prompt: You will hear a short talk. Answer the question about it.

questions.audio: N|Attention, please. Flight BA 282 to Boston has been delayed because of a technical problem. Passengers are asked to wait in the departure lounge. A new departure time will be announced at four o’clock. We apologise for the inconvenience.
questions.explanation: Transcription : Narrateur : Attention, please. Flight BA 282 to Boston has been delayed because of a technical problem. Passengers are asked to wait in the departure lounge. A new departure time will be announced at four o’clock. We apologise for the inconvenience.
questions.text: What are passengers asked to do?

questions.audio: N|Good afternoon, everyone. Before we start, I’d like to remind you that the office will be closed on Monday for the bank holiday. Also, the new security cards must be collected from reception by Friday.

questions.text: What must staff do by Friday?

choices: A product is out of stock.
questions.answer: A product is out of stock.

I’m afraid the blue sofa is out of stock, but we could deliver a grey one next week. If you’d prefer to wait for the blue one, it should be available in a month. Please call me back on 01872 554 210.
questions.text: Why is Sarah calling?

questions.audio: N|Welcome to Tintagel Castle. The castle was built in the thirteenth century and, according to legend, it was the birthplace of King Arthur. The tour lasts about an hour. Please stay on the paths, as the cliffs can be dangerous.

questions.text: What does Fresco plan to do?
